message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, sorted roughly by passenger traffic (largest to smaller but still significant hubs):

| Airport | IATA Code | City / State | Notable Features |
|---------|-----------|--------------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport | ATL | Atlanta, GA | Largest airport in the world by passenger numbers; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport | LAX | Los Angeles, CA | Major gateway to Asia and Latin America; one of the busiest west coast airports. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport | ORD | Chicago, IL | One of the oldest major hubs; major hub for United Airlines and American Airlines. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport | DFW | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX | Largest airport in Texas; major hub for American Airlines. |
| Denver International Airport | DEN | Denver, CO | Largest airport by land area in the U.S.; major hub for United and Southwest. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport | JFK | New York City, NY | Major international gateway; hub for many carriers including JetBlue and Delta. |
| San Francisco International Airport | SFO | San Francisco, CA | Major hub for United and a key gateway to Asia. |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport | SEA | Seattle, WA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and a growing hub for other carriers. |
| Miami International Airport | MIA | Miami, FL | Major hub for flights to Latin America and the Caribbean. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport | CLT | Charlotte, NC | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the fastest-growing airports. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport | PHX | Phoenix, AZ | Major hub for Southwest Airlines; high volume of domestic traffic. |
| Orlando International Airport | ORL | Orlando, FL | Major hub for leisure travel; home to many charter and low-cost carriers. |
| Newark Liberty International Airport | EWR | Newark, NJ | Major hub for United Airlines; serves the New York metropolitan area. |
| Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport | DTW | Detroit, MI | Major hub for Delta Air Lines; high cargo traffic. |

These airports serve as major hubs for both domestic and international flights and are often the primary gateways for travelers heading to or from the United States.
